svg.title: P007 · Discount amount and percentage per product
svg.desc: One row per product, including products with an unknown discount. Mug saves 100 − 80 = 20 and Lamp saves 200 − 150 = 50. Sticker keeps its row with a NULL discount. Mug saves 20 / 100 = 20%. Lamp saves 50 / 200 = 25%. The zero-price guard leaves Sticker's percentage NULL. Lamp's 25% leads Mug's 20%. SQLite places Sticker's NULL last in descending order. FROM Products · one table is enough. Discounts compare two prices for the same product. Both prices sit beside its ID and name, including on the Sticker row where the market price is zero.

g.aria-label: FROM Products · one table is enough
g.text: FROM Products · one table is enough
Discounts compare two prices for the same product. Both prices sit beside its ID and name, including on the Sticker
row where the market price is zero.

svg.text: Mug saves 100 − 80 = 20 and Lamp saves 200 − 150 = 50. Sticker keeps its row with a NULL discount.
Which price belongs in the denominator?
Mug saves 20 / 100 = 20%. Lamp saves 50 / 200 = 25%. The zero-price guard leaves Sticker's percentage NULL.
How do we rank an unknown percentage?
Lamp's 25% leads Mug's 20%. SQLite places Sticker's NULL last in descending order.
